alpha.description: Required for the local alpha candidate and normal branch CI.

preview.description: Retained in the ledger with explicit non-alpha status and no release claim.

beta.description: Future beta scope retained for traceability; it cannot make the alpha verdict pass.

future.description: Deferred scope retained for planning and does not affect alpha qualification.

entries.title: External evidence matrix gates are step-scoped and statically checked
entries.finding: GitHub Actions matrix job-level if expressions cannot safely filter matrix entries in the required reusable evidence workflows.
entries.notes: Structural validation passes locally without actionlint; the CI job installs actionlint before invoking the check.

entries.title: Alpha, preview, beta, and future requirements remain auditable
entries.finding: The historical 922-row contract did not distinguish alpha release obligations from retained non-alpha scope.
entries.notes: Current extracted counts are alpha 54, preview 713, beta 130, future 25; only the 54 required alpha rows drive release verification, with 2 explicitly blocked-external.

entries.title: Installation configuration is durable and non-secret
entries.finding: The installed launcher previously depended on the parent process environment and had no durable non-secret configuration file.
entries.notes: Provider keys, snapshot keys, tokens, and webhook secrets are excluded from installation.json and remain OS-store/environment inputs.

entries.title: Role launch environments are isolated
entries.finding: Manager and Gateway children previously inherited the complete parent environment, risking secret and role-boundary leakage.
entries.notes: The launcher now passes explicit role allowlists plus only the role token.

entries.title: Windows IPC identity is installation-scoped
entries.finding: The Windows default named pipe was a machine-global static path, allowing installations to collide.

entries.title: Windows user service install starts and status verifies running state
entries.finding: Windows task installation created a task without starting it, and status considered any successful query active.
entries.notes: The implementation adds schtasks /Run and parses a Running status.

entries.title: Context-window limits are enforced before provider I/O
entries.finding: Model contextWindow metadata was propagated but oversized requests were not rejected before credential resolution or network access.
entries.notes: The deterministic estimator is intentionally conservative and produces context_limit_exceeded before adapter streaming.

entries.title: Python SDK event streams reconnect with cursors and terminal closure
entries.finding: The Python SDK event iterator did not provide bounded reconnect, Last-Event-ID, duplicate suppression, gap detection, or terminal-run closure parity.
entries.notes: Retry budget is bounded across the iterator lifetime; deterministic focused tests passed in the worker slice.

entries.title: All Docker tool and maintenance containers use the central hardening policy
entries.finding: The Docker runtime lacked explicit swap, nofile, log-rotation, and default-seccomp policy across inline and maintenance container creation.
entries.notes: No Docker daemon claim is made by this ledger.

entries.title: Workspace mutations enforce an honest quota boundary
entries.finding: Quota preflight covered write_file but shell, process, package, Git, and patch operations could grow the workspace without an aggregate postcondition or rollback boundary.
entries.notes: All mutation-capable Docker coding tools pass through a central post-operation quota wrapper; the command result is preserved when within quota and quota violations fail closed after cleanup.

entries.title: Startup reconciliation distinguishes active durable attempts from orphans
entries.finding: Startup reconciliation must not leave an active container running after Manager death without a reattach protocol; it must reap owned containers and let run recovery mark the interrupted run ORPHANED.
entries.notes: Owned CREATED/RUNNING, STOPPING, exited, and unlinked labeled containers are reaped at Manager startup because no reattach protocol exists; RunService then marks interrupted runs ORPHANED.

entries.title: Snapshot compaction and cache garbage collection are wired into Manager lifecycle
entries.finding: SnapshotCompactorQueue and cache GC implementations exist but were not connected in optional-systems manager composition.
entries.notes: Queue coalescing, bounded concurrency, closed-queue behavior, derived snapshot keys, and Manager lifecycle wiring have focused deterministic coverage; Docker-backed evidence remains external.

entries.title: Local verification and external evidence remain separate claims
entries.finding: A local branch run cannot prove direct provider, rootless-platform, or external naming/signing evidence.
blockers: External gates require their actual GitHub runner/provider credentials and must not be fabricated locally.
entries.notes: The final verdict may only name those gates as blocked-external after all local gates pass.

entries.title: Direct provider conformance remains an external gate
entries.finding: Live direct OpenAI/Anthropic/Codex conformance cannot be established from deterministic fake-provider tests or the local Hermes proxy alone.
blockers: Requires authorized external provider credentials and the provider workflow run.
entries.notes: Never inspect or expose upstream OAuth credentials.

entries.title: The documented alpha CLI surface is complete and journey-tested
entries.finding: The current CLI exposes doctor, credentials, plugins, workspaces, migration, and service helpers but not the full init/config/run/control journey listed in the alpha brief.
entries.notes: CLI aliases now cover the frozen init/config/service/agent/workspace/run/events/approval/provider/model/plugin/prune/archive journey; local init/config and route inventory tests are deterministic, while real Docker and external provider evidence remain separate gates.

normalBranchCi.purpose: Fast deterministic branch confidence and structural truth checks.
claimsAllowed: local deterministic implementation evidence and current clean cross-platform CI evidence

candidateQualification.purpose: One clean candidate commit with compiled artifacts, package/image checks, and release truth.
claimsAllowed: VERIFIED_LOCAL_ALPHA_CANDIDATE; all locally actionable gates passed on the candidate, while unavailable Docker host/provider/naming/signing/registry authorities remain blocked-external

externalEvidence.purpose: Provider and platform evidence from the configured external workflows.
claimsAllowed: blocked-external only with an explicit blocker and no invented artifact
